Kamil #Grabara underwent surgery this afternoon for the reconstruction of the ACL of his right knee. The operation was a complete success. A 6/7 month layoff for the goalkeeper 🔚⛔️@junews24com[Marco Baridon]

MEDICAL UPDATE | GRABARA, SUCCESSFUL SURGERYKamil Grabara underwent surgery this afternoon to reconstruct the anterior cruciate ligament in his right knee.The procedure, performed at the Guardian Clinic in Konin by Dr Andrzej Pyda, in the presence of Juventus Club Doctor Dr Marco Freschi, was a complete success.The player will begin his rehabilitation programme in the coming days, with a view to returning to competitive action.[Juventus]
✅ All done for the return of #Neto to #Juventus.[Mirko Di Natale]

Norberto #Neto to #Juventus as a free agent, pending medicals. Contract until June 2027. #transfers[Nico Schira]

🇮🇹👀 #Juventus, #Carnevali is banking on the 'made in Italy': the management wants to increase the presence of Italian players in the squad. The objective is to beat the competition when it comes to young talents. In the crosshairs are especially #Raimondo from #Frosinone, on loan from #Bologna, and #Romano from #Cagliari, on loan from #Roma. These two represent potential targets for the future alongside #Ekhator.[Gazzetta dello Sport via @juventusinsidernews]

⏳✅ "The return of #Neto is practically finalized. We are one step away and at any moment the final green light could arrive. #Juventus chose him after Sergio #Rico, #Gabriel, ex #Milan and #Benevento, and several other names had also been offered. The Brazilian has shown great availability and humility from an economic standpoint. If there are no contractual hitches, the deal can be closed within the next few hours."[Fabrizio Romano - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

#Neto immediately showed great enthusiasm about returning to #Juve.His name jumped straight to the top of the list also because he knows the environment.Yesterday, a call between the player's agents and the bianconero directors to finalize the details.@CorSport[Eleonora Trotta]

🇮🇹🧐 #Juventus is also looking at the goalkeeper position for the future and among the young prospects is #Palmisani. #Frosinone has locked him down until 2031, but the bianconeri have been tracking him for some time and are evaluating an operation as early as January: buying him and leaving him on loan with the Ciociari until the end of the season. The relationship between the two clubs is solid and la Vecchia Signora wants to beat the competition.[TuttoSport via @juventusinsidernews]

🧤🆙 "Today is an important day for the goalkeeper situation. The one who convinces a bit more is #Neto. He is accepting a contract of around €500,000 for eight months and at this moment, he is very close to #Juventus. Then in June, the club will need to sign another backup if #Vicario is bought permanently, otherwise they will have to sign two goalkeepers. For the summer, I have also previously revealed the name of #Palmisani."[Nicolò Schira - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]
